ths.text: Meletis was founded on the ruins of the tyrant Agnomakhos's empire after Kynaios and Tiro, aided by Ephara's magic, overthrew him and cast out the leonin, and the two then relinquished power to a philosopher-led republic.
Ephara keeps her temple standing through an earthquake and later shares designs so the city can be rebuilt, and she visits Perisophia in dreams to warn of Xenagos.
After Elspeth slays Xenagos, Heliod makes Daxos his champion to purge Meletis of the other gods' influence, which starts a war of the gods and opens rifts to the Underworld.
Purphoros and the others respond by summoning champions from the Underworld, and Ajani spreads word in Meletis of Heliod's misdeeds.

thb.text: In Theros Beyond Death, Meletis is where Heliod makes the oracle Daxos his champion and orders him to remove the other gods from the city, so the gods go to war and make their champions demigods in response.
Perisophia tells Iris she will be escorted in secret to Soli because Purphoros's agents plan to kidnap her, and Alexio is summoned by the Twelve to take her there.
The two fall in love in a cave, and when attackers close in Alexio is shot, sends Iris away on a pegasus and stays to face the bandits.
Meanwhile Kydele returns to Meletis and keeps to herself the knowledge she gained, and the envious Diantha leaves without any insight.
